subject: Computer Studies
content: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It is used to structure web pages.

subject: Computer Studies
lesson_description: Learn how paragraphs are created in HTML.
content: The HTML paragraph element is used to create paragraphs on a web page.
practical: Create three paragraphs in an HTML document.

subject: Computer Studies
lesson_description: Learn how headings are used in HTML.
content: HTML provides different heading levels for organizing content.
practical: Create a page containing different heading levels.

subject: Computer Studies
lesson_description: Understand the basic structure of HTML elements.
content: An HTML element normally contains an opening tag and closing tag.

subject: Computer Studies
lesson_description: Learn how hyperlinks work in HTML.
content: HTML links allow users to navigate between pages and resources.
practical: Create a webpage containing three links.
